incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: alert=PD-874321 service=synthetic-liveness check=edge-liveness region=eu-west-1 window=30s failures=3/3 (12% 503s). Auto-escalation policy: primary->secondary after 2m. link: https://pd.example/alerts/PD-874321

pagerduty: Page routed to rotation `sre-eu`. Escalation schedule active. Note: auto-retry suppression disabled.

Maya (oncall): ack
Maya (oncall): pulling graphs now — looks like 3 probes (eu-probe-3, eu-probe-7, eu-probe-9) started failing ~2m ago. Not seeing matching infra spikes yet.

Sam (sre): i'm on infra. can you paste the probe logs? could be a retry-loop against relay. last deploy to prober-relay was ~20m ago?

Maya (oncall): logs attached, filtering errors
```
kubectl -n prober logs -l app=probe-runner --since=10m | egrep "ERROR|WARN" | tail -n 80
# repeated connection refused / 429 from prober-relay with immediate retry attempts
```

Leo: seeing 429 flood on prober-relay from the probe runner IPs. Rate-limit on relay is tripping and probes retry with no backoff -> amplifies failure. Suggest pause probes in eu-west and scale relay.

Maya (oncall): pausing eu-west probes now (/runbook probes pause region=eu-west). Will update PD note.

OpsBot: runbook action executed: probes paused for eu-west-1 by Maya (oncall). ActionID=RB-9921.

Priya: quick customer-impact check — internal api-errors dashboard shows small uptick in 5xx for eu-west (0.3% -> 0.6%) starting same time as probes. Likely probe traffic causing relay backpressure but monitoring to confirm. No major customer-facing outage reported yet.

Sam (sre): scaling relay to 6 replicas and increasing soft-rate-limit for probe-relay (patch applied). Also applied short fix to probe-runner backoff config (max-retries -> 2, initial-backoff=500ms).

incident-bot: PagerDuty note updated: mitigation=pausing probes eu-west, scaling relay, probe backoff change. Auto-escalation suppressed for 15m.

Maya (oncall): handing off to Sam for watch and PD follow-up in 10m. tagging @Sam :hand:

Sam (sre): will watch for 10m after re-enable. If green, i'll resolve PD and re-enable probes via runbook. Postmortem tag: provisional=no-customer-outage; will draft details.

Priya: adding postmortem label and customer-impact classification: "no-customer-visible-outage — elevated errors contained to eu-west, mitigated by probe pause and relay scaling" :white_check_mark:

Maya (oncall): closing notes: thanks team. next steps -> postmortem with timeline and probe-resilience fix (improved jitter + circuit-breaker).

Sam (sre): ack, will follow up with change PR for circuit-breaker + safer defaults. :thumbsup:"
